/index/ko.title: KO, ISSEI—EN
/index/ko.description: ISSEI—EN is a distributor of high-grade ceremonial matcha sourced exclusively from Japan.
p: This batch shows Yabukita's clean backbone under medium roast—caramelized grain depth with layered sweetness. The roast is deliberate: warm chestnut and caramel dominance, subtle chocolate undertone, no char. Pandan and hay aromatics come through in the finish. Amber liquor, full body, structured extraction. Traditional Kyoto hojicha with weight and precision.
Toasted chestnut, caramel, subtle chocolate, pandan, hay

/index/rei.title: REI, ISSEI—EN
/index/rei.description: ISSEI—EN is a distributor of high-grade ceremonial matcha sourced exclusively from Japan.
p: Stem-only hōjicha from Kaga, Ishikawa — the region recognized as the origin of this style, where roasting stem tea became a defining craft. Made exclusively from miruibo, the youngest, softest stems pulled from the first harvest. These aren't grown on purpose; they're the finest fraction sorted out from the leaf harvest itself, which is what makes them rare.
Roasted barley, dried pear, white peach, light caramel, fresh straw

/index/en.title: EN, ISSEI—EN
/index/en.description: ISSEI—EN is a distributor of high-grade ceremonial matcha sourced exclusively from Japan.
p: A blended matcha balancing first and second flush leaf. Okumidori contributes deep umami and mineral salinity; Saemidori adds natural sweetness and body. The cup is clean, savory-forward, with a rounded finish. Soft green powder with fine particle structure. Straightforward, balanced, approachable for daily use.

/index/kyo.title: KYO, ISSEI—EN
/index/kyo.description: ISSEI—EN is a distributor of high-grade ceremonial matcha sourced exclusively from Japan.
p: A refined matcha for everyday ceremony. Bright green with a clean, crisp profile. This season presents a refreshing lightness — mild vegetal bitterness balanced by natural sweetness and a smooth, even texture. The finish is short and clean, while the aroma carries bright grassy notes.

/index/uji.title: UJI, ISSEI—EN
/index/uji.description: ISSEI—EN is a distributor of high-grade ceremonial matcha sourced exclusively from Japan.
p: Uji is the traditionalist expression. A rare cultivar paired with a classic, grown the way Uji matcha has always been made. Ujihikari survives on only a handful of farms today, kept alive by growers who refused to replace it with higher-yield varieties. Samidori brings the body, Ujihikari brings the depth — together they make a cup rooted in the region that defined matcha itself.
Roasted chestnut, salted cream, butter lettuce
